verdict.rationale: Workable documents an official MCP server that gives programmatic access across the whole hiring lifecycle, from jobs and candidate sourcing through offer approvals. That lets a user drive the product in natural language through an external AI client. Natively, the evidence shows only an autonomous sourcing and screening Agent and AI-assisted candidate search, not a general natural-language command interface. Missing for 10: an in-product natural-language command or chat interface, documentation of NL operation beyond MCP tool access, and independent or hands-on corroboration that NL control works.
